days.description:
Welcome aboard

Arrive in Hurghada, where the crew will welcome you aboard. After check-in, cabin allocation, a welcome briefing and equipment setup, settle in and prepare for your Northern Red Sea adventure.

Wrecks, reefs & the Brothers

Spend the next five days diving some of Egypt's most iconic sites. Explore the spectacular reefs of Ras Mohamed National Park, discover world-famous wrecks including the SS Thistlegorm, Carnatic and Giannis D, then head offshore to the Brothers Islands for dramatic walls, vibrant coral-covered drop-offs and exciting encounters with oceanic whitetips, hammerheads, grey reef sharks and other pelagic species. The itinerary concludes around Safaga, where sites such as Abu Kifan, Panorama Reef, Tobia and Ras Abu Soma offer colourful reefs, excellent visibility and abundant marine life.

Final dives & return

Enjoy the final dives of the trip before returning to Hurghada, completing an unforgettable week of legendary wrecks, offshore reefs and world-class diving.

Disembarkation

After breakfast, disembark in Hurghada and transfer to the airport or continue your onward journey.

Please note: This is a sample itinerary. The exact route and dive sites are subject to weather, sea conditions and operational requirements, and may be adjusted at the captain's discretion.

days.description:
Welcome aboard

Arrive in Hurghada, where the crew will welcome you aboard. After check-in, cabin allocation, a welcome briefing and equipment setup, settle in and prepare for your Northern Red Sea adventure.

Wrecks, reefs & the Brothers

Spend the next five days diving some of Egypt's most iconic sites. Explore the spectacular reefs of Ras Mohamed National Park, discover world-famous wrecks including the SS Thistlegorm, Carnatic and Giannis D, then head offshore to the Brothers Islands for dramatic walls, vibrant coral-covered drop-offs and exciting encounters with oceanic whitetips, hammerheads, grey reef sharks and other pelagic species. The itinerary concludes around Safaga, where sites such as Abu Kifan, Panorama Reef, Tobia and Ras Abu Soma offer colourful reefs, excellent visibility and abundant marine life.

Safaga & final dives

Continue south towards Port Ghalib, enjoying the final dives around the reefs of Safaga, with sites such as Abu Kifan, Panorama Reef, Tobia and Ras Abu Soma offering spectacular drop-offs, coral gardens and abundant marine life.

Disembarkation

After breakfast, disembark in Port Ghalib and continue your onward journey.

Please note: This is a sample itinerary. The exact route and dive sites are subject to weather, sea conditions and operational requirements, and may be adjusted at the captain's discretion.

days.description:
Welcome aboard

Arrive in Port Ghalib, where the crew will welcome you aboard. After check-in, cabin allocation, a welcome briefing and equipment setup, settle in and prepare for an unforgettable Red Sea diving adventure.

Deep South exploration

Spend the next five days exploring Egypt's spectacular Deep South, diving the legendary reefs of Rocky Island, Zabargad, St. John's and, conditions permitting, sites such as Sataya, Claudia and Shaab Marsour. Expect dramatic walls, colourful coral gardens, swim-throughs, submerged pinnacles and exciting encounters with reef sharks, turtles, barracudas, dolphins and other pelagic species. Up to four dives per day, including night dives when conditions allow.

Elphinstone & return

Enjoy the final dives of the trip at the iconic Elphinstone Reef, renowned for its steep walls, vibrant soft corals and excellent pelagic action, before returning to Port Ghalib in the afternoon.

Disembarkation

After breakfast, disembark in Port Ghalib and transfer to the airport or your onward accommodation.

Please note: This is a sample itinerary. The exact route and dive sites are subject to weather, sea conditions and operational requirements, and may be adjusted at the captain's discretion.

unity::northern-reach-hurghada-hurghada-.highlightsDescription:
This itinerary combines the classic northern Red Sea highlights with offshore diving at the Brothers Islands, offering a more advanced and varied diving experience.

Divers will explore iconic wrecks such as the SS Thistlegorm and the Abu Nuhas reef, along with the protected reefs of Ras Mohamed and the Straits of Tiran, before heading offshore to the Brothers Islands. These exposed sites are known for their steep walls, strong currents, and the chance to encounter pelagic species including oceanic whitetip and hammerhead sharks.

This itinerary is best suited for experienced divers comfortable in currents and deeper profiles.

The Northern Reach itinerary expands on the classic northern routes by combining well-known wrecks with reef systems stretching further north toward the Sinai Peninsula.

The itinerary offers a mix of wrecks, walls, and coral reefs, with the chance to explore some less frequently visited northern dive sites.
